title: Conveyance duty abolished on commercial property up to $1.5 million (ACT)
summary: From 6 June 2018 commercial property transfers of $1.5 million or less paid no conveyance duty, and a flat $5 per $100 applied above that, as part of the ACT's move from duties to rates.

commenced.what: Nil duty on commercial transfers up to $1.5 million

direction_rationale: Stamp duty on commercial and industrial property raises the cost of moving premises; abolishing or replacing it should make it cheaper for firms to relocate, expand and match to better sites.
comparison: Other states that kept commercial stamp duty
confounders: commercial property cycle and interest rates

verified.notes: Read on the ACT register (DI2018-116, notified 4 June 2018).
